name: opem
description: Install, configure and embed the Opem Help widget from your editor: the script tag and npm packages, Content-Security-Policy, allowed origins, identity signing, documentation sync, webhooks and every error code.

interface.longDescription: Opem is a Help widget a company adds to its web app with one script tag, and a dashboard where its support staff answer. This plugin teaches your coding agent to install the widget (script tag, @opem/browser, @opem/react), set the Content-Security-Policy and allowed origins, sign identities on your server, sync your Markdoc documentation, verify webhooks, customise the widget from code and explain every error code. It holds no credentials: you copy your keys from the dashboard into your own environment file.
